# opwan Provider

Manage [opwan](https://opwan.io) tunnels, their BGP, where addresses are routed, their inbound firewalls, and opdns DNS.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    opwan = {
      source = "slop-place/opwan"
    }
  }
}

# The token can also come from OPWAN_API_TOKEN.
provider "opwan" {
  api_token = var.opwan_api_token
}

variable "opwan_api_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) An opwan API token (`opwan_...`) from the dashboard's Settings → API tokens. Reading needs a `read` token; managing the tunnel and firewalls needs `write`. Defaults to `OPWAN_API_TOKEN`. The `opwan_locations`, `opwan_plans` and `opwan_meta` data sources work without one.
- `endpoint` (String) The opwan API's base URL. Defaults to `OPWAN_ENDPOINT`, else `https://app.opwan.io`.
